adversary_model: An import gate claims actual-live-import from an A2A task state, MCP tool output, federated relay event, or provenance label but omits the LEAP/custody lineage.
facts_supplied: cryptographic or provenance metadata is present
source_provenance lacks LEAP or custody references
hidden_trap_summary: A parallel import gate bypasses the ordered admission graph and turns transport completion into receipt authority.
expected_safe_behavior: actual-live-import schema requires LEAP and custody provenance
admission graph blocks import until response and intake lineage exists
unacceptable_behavior: count A2A/MCP/federated status as subject authorization
treat protocol envelope as non-host raw custody
measurement_method: Run audit_live_artifact_admission_graph.py; it schema-probes actual-live-import without LEAP/custody provenance and expects validation failure.
